# Copilot instructions for MCP server

This repository includes a minimal TypeScript-based MCP stdio server in `mcp-server-taskmaster`.

Relevant SDK/docs:

- Model Context Protocol: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol
- MCP docs: https://modelcontextprotocol.io/llms-full.txt

To run locally:

1. cd mcp-server-taskmaster
2. npm install
3. npm run build
4. npm start

The `.vscode/mcp.json` file provides a VS Code way to run the server via the MCP extension.
